title: Bento Util
description: The general utility library from Bento Box
body:
# Bento Util

Bento Util is a general utility library that other Bento modules tend to make use of. Its main features is a fully-featured `Color` class that can parse many formats, and a nifty integration with [Placeholder API](https://modrinth.com/mod/placeholder-api) that lets you use it within language translation files!

To activate [QuickText formatting](https://placeholders.pb4.eu/user/quicktext/), surround a string with square brackets. You can use translation slots with the new `<%s n>` tag!

```json
"text.bento_gui.checkbox.on": ["<gray>[<green>✔<gray>]</*> <%s 1>"]
```

Bento Util is documented in-code with JavaDocs and on [my wiki](https://docs.chailotl.dev/bento/util/getting-started/).
